evals.name: idea-without-pain-evidence
evals.prompt: I want to build a SaaS that helps small churches schedule volunteers. Write my landing page copy.
evals.expected_output: Stops before copy: pain is not validated; runs or asks for step 1 research with real quotes.

assertions.text: says the customer pain has not been validated and starts at step 1 (research) or asks for evidence
does not write landing page copy in this turn

evals.name: enter-at-step-2-with-inputs
evals.prompt: Here are three validated pains with real quotes from r/churchtech and Capterra reviews: [quotes pasted]. Give me lead magnet ideas.
evals.expected_output: Jumps to the Strategist step: five ranked lead-magnet ideas and a pick, rooted in the quotes.

assertions.text: proposes five lead-magnet ideas ranked, and picks one
ties ideas to the pasted customer language

evals.name: no-web-access
evals.prompt: Validate demand for a meal-prep app for shift nurses. (The session has no web access.)
evals.expected_output: Says it can't search, asks the user to paste threads, reviews or interview notes.

assertions.text: says it has no web access for research
asks the user to paste real sources such as threads, reviews or interview notes
does not fabricate Reddit or review quotes
